method: Eight-dimension public UX review adapted from DesignMotionHQ for TraderCockpit.

pages.title: Page Not Found — TraderCockpit
pages.reviewed_h1: We couldn't find that page.

intent.audience: TraderCockpit prospects, users, and quantitative-research learners
intent.primary_job: Resolve the immediate page state and return to a useful public destination.
intent.worst_mistake: Failing to understand the next useful action or mistaking internal implementation state for customer-facing information.

hierarchy.focal_point: We couldn't find that page.
hierarchy.primary_action: Use the page-specific recovery or completion action
hierarchy.secondary_actions: Subordinate links may support the primary task but must not compete at equal visual weight.
hierarchy.density: Information density may be high when it serves research comprehension.

state_completeness.rule: Missing evidence remains explicit; no fallback invents product, market, or performance data.

form_ux.policy: No page-specific unlabeled input is allowed; shared local search owns its labeled input and result states.

feedback_affordance.rule: Primary actions remain reachable without hover; keyboard focus is visible; blocked actions are hidden or explained.

design_system.tokens: Shared semantic palette, 4px-derived spacing, bounded typography, focus, motion, and touch-target tokens.
design_system.state_variants: Active, focus, unavailable, loading, error, positive, negative, and neutral states remain semantically distinct.

visual_character.type: Hierarchy before ornament; article text prioritizes legibility.
visual_character.color: Warm dark surfaces, ivory text, restrained gold navigation and action accents. Analytical images retain their source colors.
visual_character.space: Use grouping and rhythm to organize dense information.
visual_character.finish: Depth and motion reinforce structure; analytical dimensionality must be justified by the underlying data.

hierarchy.density: Information density may be high when it serves research comprehension.

state_completeness.rule: Missing evidence remains explicit; no fallback invents product, market, or performance data.

form_ux.policy: No page-specific unlabeled input is allowed; shared local search owns its labeled input and result states.

feedback_affordance.rule: Primary actions remain reachable without hover; keyboard focus is visible; blocked actions are hidden or explained.

visual_character.type: Hierarchy before ornament; article text prioritizes legibility.
visual_character.color: Warm dark surfaces, ivory text, restrained gold navigation and action accents. Analytical images retain their source colors.
visual_character.space: Use grouping and rhythm to organize dense information.
visual_character.finish: Depth and motion reinforce structure; analytical dimensionality must be justified by the underlying data.
